subtitulo: Settle up, park the bag, and the sentence at the door
introPt: A traveller closes the week at the desk and leaves the door open behind them.
cenario: Hotel front desk, checkout morning, evening flight.

dialogo.pt: How much is it, all together?

dialogo.es: 宿泊税を入れて、三万千二百円になります。
dialogo.pt: With the accommodation tax, that comes to thirty-one thousand two hundred yen.
dialogo.tts: 宿泊税を入れて、三万千二百円になります。

dialogo.es: 五時まで荷物を預けてもいいですか？
dialogo.pt: Can I leave my luggage until five?
dialogo.tts: 五時まで荷物を預けてもいいですか？

dialogo.es: もちろんです。番号札をお渡ししますので、お持ちください。
dialogo.pt: Of course. I'll give you a numbered tag, please keep it.
dialogo.tts: もちろんです。番号札をお渡ししますので、お持ちください。

perguntas.pergunta: What one line often surprises a visitor on a Japanese hotel bill?
opcoes: Nothing — the total is exactly the booking figure
An accommodation tax (宿泊税), charged per person per night
perguntas.explica: Tokyo, Osaka, Kyoto, Fukuoka and others add one per night, and it is rarely mentioned at check-in. Ask for a 領収書 for expenses.

perguntas.pergunta: The desk says card is fine, but only from five thousand yen up. Is that allowed?
opcoes: No, cards must be taken for any amount
Yes — a card minimum is ordinary at a small place, and cash always settles it
perguntas.explica: Nothing obliges a business to take a card; below the minimum, pay in cash.

perguntas.pergunta: The taxi to the airport quotes one price and leaves the meter off. What is happening?
opcoes: A flat fare set for the airport run in some cities
perguntas.explica: Several cities run flat-fare airport taxis, with a receipt owed — though the train is often cheaper and faster.
Ikura desu ka — the same ending you used before committing to anything all week.

perguntas.pergunta: What closes the exchange at the door?
opcoes: Arigatou gozaimashita, and one more phrase after it
perguntas.explica: Iroiro osewa ni narimashita, then arigatou gozaimashita and shitsurei shimasu. There is no tip; the sentence is the thanks.
